entries.reason: Depends on speech models in the test identity's Application Support: it passes with an empty container and fails once Parakeet models are there, and the suite itself downloads Parakeet v3 from huggingface.co during a run. Remove when regression runs start from an empty container.
Fails on a clean simulator on 2026-11-12. The cause is not analysed yet.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: cancellation during admitted preparation joins before the lease is released. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: every meeting model publishes live speakers and the session stays in recording, not recordingDegraded. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: an explicit unsupported backend request is refused before preparation or permission. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: recording must not start without the required model. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: a model changed during admitted preparation rolls back before capture. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: a saved recording must not silently downgrade an unsupported streaming mode. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

Possible regression: since #157 an unrecoverable or escaping partial capture stays .writing instead of becoming .failed on restore (recoverClosedCapture rejects the path and the store swallows the error). Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

Possible regression: since #157 the store reconciles a session without track.json on load, rewrites the legacy session.json on read (1561 instead of 1653 bytes) and drops firstPresentationTime of a track without chunks. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

Possible regression: since #157 a reload drops firstPresentationTime of a track without chunks, so the reloaded session differs from the one the summary was made from. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
Possible regression: after #157 a failed durable write during a raw route resume no longer propagates, and echo protection stays unfiltered. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
After #157 track.json is not written where this test reads the durable boundary. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
After #157 the PCM writer no longer publishes a ready ledger terminal where this test expects it. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
After #157 the refusal path fails with Cocoa error 4 while removing a session directory. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
After #157 the full comparison does not save a usable report within 5 seconds. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

#157 keeps recording when model validation fails and defers speech. On iOS this test now reaches the permission preflight after a failed model installation, while it states that a failed installation leaves no capture. Needs a decision from the owner of #157 (issue #169). Fails alone on a clean simulator; it passed on the base before #157.
